newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Hartford Life higher.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Hartford Life higher.

text.p: Shares of life insurer Hartford Life Inc gained substantially at their debut on Thursday, climbing 4-3/8 to 32-5/8 in midday trading.
With over six million shares exchanging hands, the issue topped the list of most active stocks on the New York Stock Exchange.

Shares were priced at $28.25 each, above the anticipated range of $24 to $27 a share. The global offering consisted of 23 million shares, with 18.4 million slated for the United States. Goldman Sachs was lead underwriter on the deal.
"Our call was for three to five points higher (at the open)," said David Menlow, president of Springfield, N,J.-based IPO Financial Network Corp.
And indeed, the stock opened with a $4.75 premium at $33 a share.

"I have held this to be the second jewel in the IPO trilogy crown for the second quarter," said Menlow. Hertz Corp was the first, and Polo Ralph Lauren, which yesterday set the terms for its $700 million IPO, is the third.
